title: CTRL-2.2: policy-controlled bowl carry
why: Scout: jn784a4mm8364w2gwt89qa6vax8h8eth Task: js75dcnc5q7tg2takfw70twtpn8gsaxs. Current fixture teleports bowl and robot, scripts palm waypoints, then walks while bowl remains island-supported. Policy must lift before gait.

ops.text: At authored bowl pose, model lifts with joint actions and finger contact, carries bowl 0.3 m under 0.2 m/s walk command, then releases into gravity drop; no fixed waypoints, weld, snap, or teleport.
